judge.rationale: The candidate stopped mid-implementation, leaving `.lore/dod.md` in the tree and an unrequested `src/orchestration/tools/registry.acceptance.test.ts` file. Furthermore, `new Ajv({allErrors: true, format: false})` uses an invalid Ajv v8 option (`format: false` instead of `validateFormats: false`) and default `import Ajv from 'ajv'` which causes TypeScript/ESM issues under `NodeNext` module resolution compared to the reference's named import `import {Ajv} from 'ajv'`. Most acceptance criteria were missed: `registry.test.ts` only has 1 of the required 7 unit tests, `chatOrchestrator.test.ts` was not updated at all, and none of `README.md`, `docs/adding-a-tool.md`, `.specify/spec.md`, or `example/weather-tool.ts` were updated. The `CHANGELOG.md` entry is also incomplete, only mentioning `register` compilation and omitting `execute` validation and the migration note.
